- Date: 2026-05-28  
  Link: [Anthropic — Introducing Claude Opus 4.8](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-8)  
  Summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, available on Claude, API, and major cloud platforms at existing Opus 4.7 pricing. The release adds effort controls on Claude.ai and Cowork, cheaper fast mode, and Messages API support for system entries inside the messages array.
